objects.description: [CanisterWorm](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9042) has checked if the current user is root. If it is, [CanisterWorm](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9042) will wipe the system using `rm –rf / --no-preserve-root`. If it is not, [CanisterWorm](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9042) will try passwordless sudo and will run the same command.(Citation: Aikido CanisterWorm MAR 2026)
